items.title: Every simplicial object is the colimit of its skeleta with injective transition maps
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-abelian-limit-skeleta at source lines 3804-3812: in an abelian category every simplicial object V is the colimit of the induced skeleta i_{n!} sk_n V, with all transition maps injective. The proof at source lines 3814-3819 is a one-line degree argument: in degree m the n-th skeleton already agrees with V as soon as n is at least m, which identifies the colimit with V, and the injectivity of the transition maps is the cited skeleton lemma. It is the tersest item in this half of the chapter, but the argument given is the actual reason and reduces the claim to the cited lemma.
